steps.title: Daily Site Report
steps.ask: I want to fill today's daily site report.
fill: Okay, let's start a daily report. This one's for Dixie Road and Mayfield Road, on the Dixie corridor site. It was a day shift, and the supervisor is Gurpreet Sandhu.
For work progress, on item C-15 a, ninety percent of the Granular A is complete. The remaining ten percent will be completed by next week.
For labour, on the same item, we had one Foreman Open Cut and four Labourer Open Cut. They each put in ten hours.
For equipment, on the same item, we had the 40 tonne excavator going for ten hours.
For quantities, on item C-15 a, we placed three hundred tonnes.
For delays, we lost two hours this morning, waiting on Bell to locate a duct bank at station fourteen plus two-eighty.
For weather, it was partly cloudy, twelve degrees.
